title: Can ChatGPT evaluate research environments? Evidence from REF2021
findings: The LLM's scores for research environment statements in the 'Theology and Religious Studies' unit of assessment had a high Spearman correlation (ρ = 0.761) with the scores from human experts, indicating strong performance in this area, similar to fields like Sociology and Psychology.
